GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091 (11 Jan 46) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN-576)
APO 500
11 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Imperial Household Property.
1. Reference is made to C. L. O. No. 1395 (2. 1) 27 December 1945. subject: “Imperial Household Property.”
2. The applications contained therein for permission to pay from available funds minor deficits in connection with normal operations of the Imperial Household are approved.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.Allen
Colonel,A.G.D.
Asst Adjutant General
